anomalies.observed: On the 'Water Height Sensor' block of the root sheet, the TF-Luna LiDAR module PR1 (pins VCC/SDA/SCL/GND/TX) is drawn wired through connector H1/P1 onto the board: VCC to +5V (with C1 100u decoupling to GND), SDA to the I2C_SDA net, SCL to the I2C_SCL net, and GND/TX to GND. There are no no-connect flags on PR1.
anomalies.expected: The intended design leaves PR1 unconnected and unpopulated. Spec: 'the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no, in_bom: yes, and all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design' and 'This sensor is documented in the schematic/BOM but not implemented in either the r2 PCB wiring or the current firmware.' Water-level sensing that is actually wired/used is the HC-SR04 ultrasonic on two GPIOs, not the LiDAR.

the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no, in_bom: yes, and all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design. It also does not appear anywhere in esphome/hydroponics-controller.yaml

anomalies.impact: An extra 5 V I2C rangefinder is placed on the 3.3 V I2C bus and powered from +5 V, although no firmware drives it. This loads the bus, draws current the reference build does not, and a 5 V open-drain device can pull SDA/SCL toward 5 V, over-driving the 3.3 V ESP32 pins and the ADM3260 primary side (risk of damage / bus malfunction). It also means the board's water-level path differs from the intended ultrasonic design.

parsed.summary: The schematic deviates from the intended design by wiring the TF-Luna LiDAR (PR1) onto the +5V and I2C_SDA/I2C_SCL nets via H1/P1 with decoupling C1, whereas the specification's reference design explicitly leaves PR1 unwired (pins free, on_board: no) and uses an ultrasonic sensor instead; this adds an un-driven 5V device to the 3.3V I2C bus.
